profile.headline: Software Engineering Manager at Descript
profile.summary:
With over 16 years of experience in web development, I have held various positions, including a Software Engineer Manager at Udemy, where I led a team of engineers to create engaging and accessible online learning platforms using modern technologies like Python and React. As a strong advocate for mentorship and professional development, I enjoy sharing my knowledge and experience with junior developers and guiding them towards success.

Previously, I worked as a Senior Staff Engineer and Development Team Leader at companies like Udemy and Unidad Editorial, respectively. In these roles, I was responsible for delivering high-quality web applications and solutions for various media outlets and audiences. Passionate about web development and innovation, I enjoy collaborating with developers, designers, and stakeholders to create user-friendly and impactful web experiences.

I'm always eager to learn new skills and technologies and value diversity, inclusion, and creativity in my work.
